name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A fine ring for work of unknown duration.
use: A short wait with nothing to show yet: a busy button, a field that checks its value, a panel that loads. Alone it has role="status" and an aria-label; beside text that says the same it has aria-hidden="true".

instead.when: The shape of the coming content is known
Words can say what is happening
The amount of work done is known

classes.name: spinner
classes.description: The ring, 16px, in the current text color

classes.name: spinner-inline
classes.description: As large as the icons of the control around it, or 1em where no control sets an icon size

properties.name: --spinner-size
properties.description: Diameter of the ring; a control may set it for the spinner it holds

properties.name: --icon-size
properties.description: Read from the control around the spinner; the stylesheet falls back to 1em
